# Silent empty extraction fallback in FakeLLMProvider

When no substring in the configured responses matches the prompt, the fake provider returns an empty extraction ({'business_rules': [], 'features': [], 'risks': []}), which may silently mask missing test fixtures or mismatches between prompts and configured responses.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/provider.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.provider.FakeLLMProvider.complete`
